title: My conclusion about MallWorld after some studies

classification.theory_summary: Proposes that “MallWorld” dreams are explained by factors like anxiety/choice overload, nostalgia/childhood memories, social-connection needs, transition/change themes, and topic priming/collective-symbol exposure (e.g., vaporwave/liminal-space imagery).
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative or concrete, first-person phenomenological scene description; content is explanatory/theoretical about why people dream of malls/schools/crowds.

meta.author_theory: MallWorld dreams may relate to consumption/stress environments (malls/supermarkets), childhood/adolescent memories (also schools), social-connection needs, crowded vs empty settings, nostalgia (incl. vaporwave/mallsoft/liminal imagery), life transition/movement themes (bus stations/flow), and increased frequency after learning/discussing the topic (shared symbols/collective exposure).

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains generalized descriptions of common MallWorld-related settings (malls/supermarkets/schools/bus stations; crowded or empty) and emotions (melancholy, loneliness, nostalgia) but does not describe a particular dream episode with extractable locations, routes, boundaries, or events.
